correctness.rationale: PASS: Every nondegenerate planar trapezoid with bases a<=b is affinely equivalent to K_τ=conv{(0,0),(1,0),(τ,1),(0,1)}, τ=a/b∈(0,1], area=(1+τ)/2. Its difference-body polar D° is the intersection |x|<=1, |x−y|<=1, |τx+y|<=1, whose six listed vertices have all 15 pairwise determinant magnitudes in {0,1−τ,1}. Thus |det(u,v)| <= w_K(Ju)w_K(Jv) for all vectors, and the segment mixed areas V₂(K,[0,u])=w_K(Ju)/2, V₂([0,u],[0,v])=|det(u,v)|/2 yield coefficient 1+τ. Positive mixed-area bilinearity extends the segment inequality to zonotopes; Hausdorff continuity covers all zonoids. Orthogonal coordinate segments attain equality exactly (interior tests approximate by thin parallelograms). Independent exact rational half-plane intersection and determinant enumeration confirmed τ=1/4,1/2,3/4,1; the symbolic vertex argument proves every real τ. The theorem does not claim general noncentrally symmetric test bodies.
